messages:
Sam H: Heads-up — noticed a bug in the python SDK async error handling. When running the async client and the server returns a validation error payload with 'code' + 'status', the raised exception only has .message and we lose status/code. Short repro below.

Sam H:```py
async def f():
    async with Client() as c:
        await c.responses.create(prompt='')
# server returns 400 + body: {"error": {"message": "prompt too short", "code": "invalid_input", "status": 400}}
```

Jordan N: Can you paste the actual exception obj/stack? Is it from httpx or our wrapper?

Sam H: It's our wrapper. stack shows
```
raise ClientError(str(e))
ClientError: HTTP 400
```
We drop the parsed JSON and re-raise a generic ClientError. Happens only in async mode (sync path keeps the parsed fields).

Maria G: Hmm — probably because we call `await resp.aread()` then `json()` and on some flows `json()` raises, so we catch and wrap. But wrapping should attach original payload. Can you add the exact response body? Also, which version of python-sdk?

Sam H: body was `{ "error": { "message": "prompt too short", "code": "invalid_input", "details": {"field":"prompt"} } }`. SDK v0.9.3.

Jordan N: Repro'd locally. Root cause: `exceptions.py` has `raise ClientError(str(http_error))` in the async codepath but in sync it constructs `ApiError(status_code=..., code=..., details=...)`. Simple fix: carry the parsed fields into AsyncApiError. I'll open a PR.

Jordan N: Quick patch idea: set `AsyncApiError.__init__(..., raw_body, parsed)` and attach `parsed.get('error')` fields to attributes. Also add typing in `exceptions.pyi`: `class ApiError(Exception): status_code: Optional[int]; code: Optional[str]; details: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]` so IDEs pick it up.

Maria G: Also add fallback for non-json body — we saw cases where `resp.content == b''` and `resp.json()` raises `JSONDecodeError`. Keep original text in `.raw_body` and don't swallow.

Sam H: Another thing — when these exceptions travel across tasks/gather they get stringified and downstream code only sees `str(e)`. Could we implement `__repr__`/`__str__` that includes `.status_code` and `.code`? And make these exceptions picklable so they preserve attributes when propagated from background tasks.

Jordan N: Agree. I'll include `__str__` override and make sure exception is picklable (attrs only basic types). Will add unit test to ensure async path preserves error fields and sync/async parity. PR 3421.

dev-ci: build started for PR 3421 — https://ci.redwood/3421

Sam H: thx. small UX ask: can we also map 422 -> `ValidationError` subclass so callers can do `except ValidationError as e:`? Right now it's just `ApiError`.

Maria G: Good call. We'll add a `ValidationError(ApiError)` and set it when `status_code==422` or `error.code == 'validation_error'`.

Jordan N: Assigning to @jordan, ETA EOD. Repro case + unit test included.

Sam H: :+1: Thanks gang.

Maria G: leaving a note to update changelog and release notes about improved exception model.
